name: ascent-ios-local
description: Native iOS wrapper for ASCENT; online sync with an explicit offline test mode

scripts.sync:ios: npm run build:ios-assets && cap sync ios && npm run verify:ios-assets
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulator.json --project demo-ascent-rules --only firestore --non-interactive "node tests/firestore/score-metadata.mjs"
